# Full Feature Requirements Review Checklist: User Role and Account Management

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and scenario coverage of the full feature requirements before implementation or merge
**Created**: 2026-08-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all eight user stories traceable to functional requirements and measurable outcomes, including an explicit explanation for the missing FR-008 identifier? [Completeness, Traceability, Spec §User Scenarios, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [x] CHK002 Are reinstatement requirements defined for the suspended-account state described as reversible? [Gap, Spec §User Story 5, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Are session creation, expiry, renewal, revocation, and optional Remember Me requirements documented in the feature specification rather than only introduced by the implementation plan? [Gap, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec explicitly prohibit account deletion and define suspension as the only reversible removal-from-access mechanism while retaining account data and canonical-email ownership? [Scope, Spec §FR-014, Governance §GOV-002]
- [x] CHK005 Are deployment and repeat-deployment requirements defined for creating, validating, rotating, or preserving the initial Admin account? [Gap, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Are minimum password strength requirements quantified consistently for invitation registration, self-service reset, and forced reset? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004b, Spec §User Story 7]
- [x] CHK007 Is the password-reset link lifetime specified, including the exact start and end of its validity period? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK008 Are the lockout threshold, lockout duration, failed-attempt reset conditions, and deployment-time configurability stated as normative requirements rather than assumptions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024–FR-026]
- [x] CHK009 Is “immediately” defined for access changes caused by suspension, promotion, forced reset, password reset, and profile updates, including the treatment of existing sessions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-028–FR-029, Spec §FR-040, Spec §FR-045]
- [x] CHK010 Are length, character, whitespace, and normalization rules specified for names, phone numbers, Slack handles, and email addresses? [Gap, Spec §FR-030–FR-034, Spec §FR-046–FR-049]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the active-Admin protections consistent with Member-only management actions, the no-deletion policy, and the prohibition on demoting or managing Admin accounts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-050]
- [x] CHK012 Are suspension and reinstatement defined consistently in functional requirements and acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 5, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK013 Are the plan’s fixed session expiry and optional Remember Me behavior consistent with the specification’s stated scope and success criteria? [Consistency, Plan §Summary, Spec §FR-037–FR-040]
- [x] CHK014 Are profile visibility requirements consistent with the intentional authenticated-team disclosure of Phone Number and Slack Handle? [Consistency, Privacy, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-032, Spec §FR-060]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Is the profile-view performance outcome quantified by data volume, concurrency, environment, percentile, sample size, and measurement boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK016 Does the three-minute invitation outcome define when timing begins and ends and how external email-delivery time is treated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-020]
- [x] CHK017 Is a control activation defined sufficiently to measure the three-interaction account-management outcome across edit, suspend, reinstate, and promote flows? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK018 Are measurable outcomes provided for password reset, lockout recovery, forced reset, avatar management, and suspended-account reinstatement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008–SC-015]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are resend and recovery requirements defined after an invitation expires, is lost, is delayed, or cannot be delivered? [Recovery Flow, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-051]
- [x] CHK020 Are exception requirements specified for invitation and password-reset email rejection, timeout, delay, and duplicate delivery? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-052–FR-053]
- [x] CHK021 Are concurrent suspension, reinstatement, promotion, and Admin-targeting attempts addressed with an unambiguous outcome that preserves the active-Admin invariant? [Alternate Flow, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-050]
- [x] CHK022 Are forced-reset requirements complete for Members who are suspended, temporarily locked, already signed in, or using an expired restricted reset flow? [Alternate Flow, Spec §FR-023–FR-029, Spec §FR-054]
- [x] CHK023 Are active-session outcomes specified after password changes, role promotion, suspension, reinstatement, and forced-reset assignment? [Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-013–FR-016, Spec §FR-036, Spec §FR-040, Spec §FR-045, Spec §FR-054]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are case differences, surrounding whitespace, aliases, and canonicalization rules addressed when comparing invited, registered, and reset-request email addresses? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-003–FR-007, Spec §FR-019–FR-021]
- [x] CHK025 Does the spec define that suspended accounts retain canonical-email ownership and how their invitation and reset links behave? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for partial avatar replacement failures so the prior avatar and profile state have a deterministic outcome? [Gap, Recovery Flow, Spec §User Story 8, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK027 Is the no-op behavior for removing a nonexistent avatar promoted from an edge-case note into a traceable requirement or acceptance criterion? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK028 Are concurrent uses of multiple valid invitations for the same unregistered email addressed so the resulting account and error outcomes are unambiguous? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-004–FR-007]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Are accessibility requirements specified for authentication forms, profile management, status/error messages, avatar controls, and forced-reset gating? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-056, Spec §SC-016]
- [x] CHK030 Are confidentiality, tamper-resistance, entropy, transport, storage, and exposure requirements defined for invitation, password-reset, forced-reset, and session credentials? [Security, Spec §FR-057–FR-058, Spec §SC-017]
- [x] CHK031 Are abuse-prevention requirements quantified for login attempts, invitation sends, password-reset requests, and token validation? [Security, Spec §FR-024–FR-026, Spec §FR-059, Spec §SC-018]
- [x] CHK032 Are data privacy, indefinite suspended-account retention, authenticated disclosure, logging, avatar access, and the no-deletion policy specified? [Privacy, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-060–FR-062, Governance §GOV-002]
- [x] CHK033 Are avatar security requirements complete for content validation, metadata handling, malicious content, authenticated access, dimensions, and persisted storage consumption? [Security, Spec §FR-061, Spec §SC-019]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK034 Are availability expectations and degraded-mode requirements documented for the external email service used by invitations and password resets? [Dependency, Spec §FR-052–FR-053, Spec §SC-020]
- [x] CHK035 Are durability, backup retention, restore testing, and deployment expectations documented for application-managed avatar files? [Dependency, Spec §FR-062]
- [x] CHK036 Is the approval status of Nodemailer supported by a traceable governance decision that names its purpose and why a built-in alternative is insufficient? [Dependency, Traceability, Governance §GOV-001, Constitution §IV]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK037 Is the deliberate inability to revoke stateless invitation links documented with explicit security acceptance criteria and operator-facing consequences? [Security Acceptance, Spec §FR-063, Spec §SC-017]
- [x] CHK038 Is permanent account deletion explicitly removed from scope so no deletion-retention, audit-copy, backup, or restoration conflict remains? [Resolved Scope, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-041, Governance §GOV-002]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
